Reading players data, dropping columns that won't be used for the analysis. 
```{r}
players <- data.table::as.data.table(RcppSimdJson::fload(here("data", "players.json")))
player_rankings <- data.table::as.data.table(RcppSimdJson::fload(here("data", "playerank.json")))

players <- data.table::merge.data.table(x = player_rankings, y = players, by.x = c('playerId'), by.y = c('wyId'))
player_rankings <- NULL
gc()

drop_cols <- c(
  "passportArea", "weight", "birthArea", "height",
  "shortName", "birthDate", "role", 'currentNationalTeamId', 'currentTeamId'
)
keep_cols <- setdiff(colnames(players), drop_cols)
players <- players[, ..keep_cols]
```

```{r}
leagues <- c("England", "France", "Germany", "Italy", "Spain", "World_Cup", "European_Championship")
```


```{r}
matches_loc <- here::here("data", "matches")

matches <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(leagues, function(league) {
  dt <- data.table::as.data.table(
    RcppSimdJson::fload(file.path(matches_loc, paste0("matches_", league, ".json")))
  )
  dt[, league := league]
}), fill = TRUE)
```

```{r}
matches[, groupName := NULL]
```

```{r}
drop_cols <- c("roundId", "referees", "competitionId", "groupName", "winner", "venue", "status", "label")
keep_cols <- setdiff(colnames(matches), drop_cols)

matches <- matches[, ..keep_cols]

```

`recent_player strength:` Exponentially weighted moving average of player performance. 


```{r}
players <- data.table::merge.data.table(x = matches[, c("dateutc", "matchId")], y = players, by.x = "matchId", by.y = "matchId", all.y = TRUE)
```

```{r}
players[, dateutc := as.POSIXct(dateutc, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")]

setorder(players, playerId, dateutc)
```

```{r}
alpha <- 0.3

players[, ewma_rank := {
  ewma <- Reduce(
    function(acc, x) alpha * x + (1 - alpha) * acc,
    playerankScore,
    accumulate = TRUE
  )
  shifted <- shift(ewma, n = 1)
}, by = playerId]
```

```{r}
players[, is_debut := is.na(ewma_rank)]
```


```{r}
# see how quickly different alphas decay
alphas <- c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7)
decay <- sapply(alphas, function(a) a * (1 - a)^(0:15))

matplot(decay,
  type = "l", lty = 1,
  xlab = "Games ago", ylab = "Weight",
  main = "EWMA decay by alpha"
)
legend("topright", legend = paste("alpha =", alphas), col = 1:4, lty = 1)
```



```{r}
compute_team_strength <- function(lineup, matchId, side) {
  lineup$matchId <- matchId
  lineup <- data.table::merge.data.table(
    x = lineup,
    y = players[, c("playerId", "matchId", "ewma_rank")],
    by.x = c("playerId", "matchId"),
    by.y = c("playerId", "matchId")
  )

  if (side == "home") {
    if (sum(is.na(lineup)) > 3) {
      return(list(
        matchId = matchId,
        homeMeanStr = NA_real_,
        homeMinStr = NA_real_,
        homeMaxStr = NA_real_,
        homeBalance = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    return(list(
      matchId = matchId,
      homeMeanStr = mean(lineup$ewma_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
      homeMinStr = min(lineup$ewma_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
      homeMaxStr = max(lineup$ewma_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
      homeBalance = sd(lineup$ewma_rank, na.rm = TRUE)
    ))
  } else {
    if (sum(is.na(lineup)) > 3) {
      return(list(
        matchId = matchId,
        awayMeanStr = NA_real_,
        awayMinStr = NA_real_,
        awayMaxStr = NA_real_,
        awayBalance = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    return(list(
      matchId = matchId,
      awayMeanStr = mean(lineup$ewma_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
      awayMinStr = min(lineup$ewma_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
      awayMaxStr = max(lineup$ewma_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
      awayBalance = sd(lineup$ewma_rank, na.rm = TRUE)
    ))
  }
}

# initialise new columns
matches[, homeId := NA_real_]
matches[, homeMeanStr := NA_real_]
matches[, homeMinStr := NA_real_]
matches[, homeMaxStr := NA_real_]
matches[, homeBalance := NA_real_]
matches[, awayId := NA_real_]
matches[, awayMeanStr := NA_real_]
matches[, awayMinStr := NA_real_]
matches[, awayMaxStr := NA_real_]
matches[, awayBalance := NA_real_]
for (i in seq_len(nrow(matches))) {
  match_idx <- matches$matchId[i]
  td <- matches$teamsData[[i]]
  home_idx <- which(sapply(td, function(x) x$side) == "home")
  away_idx <- which(sapply(td, function(x) x$side) == "away")

  home_result <- compute_team_strength(td[[home_idx]]$formation$lineup, match_idx, td[[home_idx]]$side)
  away_result <- compute_team_strength(td[[away_idx]]$formation$lineup, match_idx, td[[away_idx]]$side)
  matches[matchId == match_idx, 'homeId' := td[[home_idx]]$teamId]
  matches[matchId == match_idx, "homeMeanStr" := home_result$homeMeanStr]
  matches[matchId == match_idx, "homeMinStr" := home_result$homeMinStr]
  matches[matchId == match_idx, "homeMaxStr" := home_result$homeMaxStr]
  matches[matchId == match_idx, "homeBalance" := home_result$homeBalance]
  matches[matchId == match_idx, 'awayId' := td[[away_idx]]$teamId]
  matches[matchId == match_idx, "awayMeanStr" := away_result$awayMeanStr]
  matches[matchId == match_idx, "awayMinStr" := away_result$awayMinStr]
  matches[matchId == match_idx, "awayMaxStr" := away_result$awayMaxStr]
  matches[matchId == match_idx, "awayBalance" := away_result$awayBalance]
}
```




```{r}
events_loc <- here::here("data", "events")

events <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(leagues, function(league) {
  dt <- data.table::as.data.table(
    RcppSimdJson::fload(file.path(events_loc, paste0("events_", league, ".json")))
  )
  dt[, league := league]
}), fill = TRUE)
```

```{r}
events <- merge.data.table(x = events, y = players, by = c("playerId", "matchId"), all.x = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# teamsData is a list column - unnest it
teams_long <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(matches)), function(i) {
  td <- matches$teamsData[[i]]
  data.table::rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(td), function(j) {
    list(
      matchId = matches$matchId[i],
      teamId = td[[j]]$teamId,
      side = td[[j]]$side,
      score = td[[j]]$score
    )
  }))
}))
```

something I should do is probably do is back cast player performance. Also I need to get an overall picture of team performance as well. I'll take a mean of player rank, though this might not be optimal.
```{r}
home <- teams_long[side == "home"]
away <- teams_long[side == "away"]

setnames(home,
  old = c("teamId", "score", "side"),
  new = c("homeTeamId", "homeScore", "homeSide")
)
setnames(away,
  old = c("teamId", "score", "side"),
  new = c("awayTeamId", "awayScore", "awaySide")
)

matches_wide <- data.table::merge.data.table(
  x = home,
  y = away,
  by = "matchId"
)

matches_wide <- data.table::merge.data.table(
  x = matches_wide,
  y = matches,
  by = "matchId"
)
```
